items.title: Nvidia partner Hon Hai’s sales climb 52% as Europe lines up its own orders
items.summary:
Hon Hai reported August revenue of NT$921.8B, about $29.1B, up 52% year on year on AI server demand, well ahead of analyst expectations for the quarter. items.title: Chinese profits rose 25.7%. The CSI 300 fell 9% and the Star 50 fell 29%
items.summary:
Profits at onshore-listed Chinese companies rose 25.7% in the three months to June, the fastest in nearly five years and heavily concentrated in AI-linked firms. The CSI 300 has fallen about 9% this quarter and the tech-heavy Star 50 has dropped 29%, as investors began treating AI spending as a cost rather than a promise. […]

items.title: Agentic Loops for Knowledge Workers
items.summary: A holiday-week special: NLW hands the mic to Nufar Gaspar for a webinar on the buzziest skill of the summer — loop and graph engineering — and how to drag it out of software engineering and into knowledge work. The core move: coders got verification for free; the rest of us have to manufacture the referee. If you can define a boring, checkable finish line, agents will run until the job is actually done — and when one loop isn't enough, you compose them into teams.

items.summary:
